summary: Learn BEC and payment fraud prevention with verification controls, fraud scenarios, and practical tools. Train your team today.
lede: Email-based payment fraud prevention helps finance, procurement and treasury teams verify payment instructions before funds move. The training covers spotting impersonation and invoice diversion, checking vendor bank-detail changes through known-number call-backs and dual approvals, and understanding email authentication concepts such as SPF, DKIM and DMARC. Participants also practice incident escalation, evidence preservation and fraud-exception reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who handle payment approvals, vendor changes, fraud checks, and control oversight in finance-led workflows.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of finance or procurement processes, especially invoice handling, vendor setup, and payment approval steps. Familiarity with email, spreadsheets, and basic internal control concepts is recommended; no coding is required. The course uses practical payment-fraud scenarios, so you should be ready to review sample emails, approval forms, and control checklists.
